# The clock period each design achieves under Vivado 2026.1's timer at
# xc7a100tftg256-3, in ns: each clock's period less the worst setup slack from
# it to itself (tools/vivado-parity/achieved.sh, `achieved.py table --fixture`),
# for the designs of this directory whose arrangement changed and for
# testdata/fpga/vivado/analyser_fifo.v. Run on 2026-11-07.
#   vivado <design> <clock> <ns>    Vivado's own flow, synthesis to routes, the
#                                   best of three runs at tightening periods
#   netlist <design> <clock> <ns>   Vivado's placement and routes of the
#                                   `after` build's netlist, seed 1
#   reticle <build> <seed> <design> <clock> <ns>
#                                   Reticle's placement and routes, timed by
#                                   Vivado: `before` is 73334987 (f8625a1d made the
#                                   same figures), `after` the arrangement of
#                                   docs/fpga-vivado-parity.md, "Memories as
#                                   Vivado arranges them"
# `tdp_*` has no `before`: it did not build. Vivado's own flow puts
# `sdp_32x32`, `sdp_512x36`, `sdp_512x64` and `sp_wf_1024x18` in distributed RAM
# at these periods (`Synth 8-5584`), and in block RAM at 5 ns.
